title: dd.arch
description: An architecture doc (arch/v1) embedded from its published arch.json: a system at every zoom level, with labeled lines, sticky notes, the main path and stories.

src.description: The arch.json URL, relative to the page or absolute, such as ../../architecture/durable-agents/arch.json.

focus.description: A node id to open zoomed into; defaults to the doc's start or its top level.

fill.description: Draw the whole map at the figure's height instead of the names-only glimpse.
